title: Find the ID and age of the oldest male patient who has had at least two lab
question: Find the ID and age of the oldest male patient who has had at least two laboratory tests showing albumin levels outside the normal range and also exhibits a total cholesterol level above 250.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058", STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1."XCL_060")
FROM Patient AS T1
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND T1."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT "XCL_014" FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "XCL_031" < 3.5 OR "XCL_031" > 5.5
    GROUP BY "XCL_014"
    HAVING COUNT("XCL_014") >= 2
  )
  AND T1."XCL_058" IN (
    SELECT "XCL_014" FROM Laboratory WHERE "XCL_026" > 250
  )
ORDER BY T1."XCL_060" ASC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_058" || ' ' || T1."XCL_060"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_001"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'M'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_058"
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_024" < 1.5 OR T2."XCL_024" > 4.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
   AND MAX(T3."XCL_003") > 250
ORDER BY T1."XCL_060" DESC
LIMIT 1

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    p.XCL_058 AS id,
    p.XCL_060 AS age
FROM 
    Patient p
JOIN 
    Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE 
    p.XCL_063 = 'M'
    AND l.XCL_020 > 250
    AND (
        (l.XCL_021 < 3.5 OR l.XCL_021 > 5.5)
    )
GROUP BY 
    p.XCL_058, p.XCL_060
HAVING 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN (l.XCL_021 < 3.5 OR l.XCL_021 > 5.5) THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 
    p.XCL_060 DESC
LIMIT 1
